profile.Name: Yabuta Chief
profile.Personality: A cruel outlaw chief who likes to watch victims suffer and despises the weak.
profile.Backstory: A leader of the Yabuta Outlaws, based in the headquarters of Fort Yabuta, formerly Fort Simion. He says his outlaws are back to reclaim the desert.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Boasts that the desert belongs to his outlaws and that the weak will burn.
